    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    k = (n - 1) // 2
    for i in range(k + 1):
        pos = i
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if a[j] < a[pos]:
                pos = j
        a[i], a[pos] = a[pos], a[i]
    print(a[k])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
